# Nueco Frontend - Comprehensive Project Analysis

## 1. Project Introduction

**Nueco** is a sophisticated cross-platform mobile application built with React Native and Expo, designed as a comprehensive note-taking and productivity platform. The application focuses on end-to-end encryption (E2EE) for data privacy, seamless calendar integration, and voice-enabled features.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Privacy-First Design**: Implement robust end-to-end encryption for all user data including notes, events, and attachments
- **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Support iOS, Android, and web platforms through React Native and Expo ecosystem
- **Offline-First Architecture**: Ensure full functionality without internet connectivity with intelligent sync mechanisms
- **Calendar Integration**: Seamless synchronization with device calendars and Google Calendar
- **Voice Recording**: Advanced audio recording capabilities with speech-to-text conversion
- **Rich Content Editing**: Full-featured editor supporting images, tables, and rich text formatting

### Target Audience
- Privacy-conscious users requiring secure note-taking
- Professionals needing calendar integration and event management
- Users seeking offline-first productivity tools
- Teams requiring encrypted collaboration capabilities

## 2. Technical Architecture

The application follows a modular architecture pattern with clear separation of concerns:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[App Entry Point] --> B[Authentication Layer]
    A --> C[Routing System]
    A --> D[Crypto Engine]
    
    B --> E[Auth Context]
    C --> F[Tab Navigation]
    C --> G[Screen Components]
    D --> H[E2EE Encryption]
    
    F --> I[Notes Screen]
    F --> J[Events Screen]
    F --> K[Calendar Screen]
    
    G --> L[Editor Component]
    G --> M[Settings Screens]
    
    H --> N[Note Encryption]
    H --> O[Event Encryption]
    H --> P[Attachment Encryption]
    
    I --> Q[Offline Sync]
    J --> R[Calendar Sync]
    K --> S[Device Calendar API]
```

### Key Architectural Patterns

**End-to-End Encryption Architecture**:
- Client-side encryption using AES-256-GCM with @noble/ciphers
- Key derivation via PBKDF2 with native optimization for performance
- Secure key escrow system with password and recovery code support
- Zero-knowledge architecture where server never sees plaintext data

**Offline-First Data Management**:
- Local-first data storage with background synchronization
- Conflict resolution algorithms for multi-device scenarios
- Queue-based operation queuing for network operations
- Intelligent caching strategies for optimal performance

**Modular Feature Architecture**:
- Feature-specific modules (auth, crypto, calendar, audio, share)
- Platform abstraction layers for native functionality
- Plugin-based architecture for extensible features

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **Application Root**: `app/_layout.tsx` - Sets up global providers, routing, and initialization
- **Tab Navigation**: `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` - Main notes interface with search and filtering
- **Configuration**: `app.config.js` - Dynamic configuration with feature flags and build-time settings

### Core Modules

**Authentication System** (`src/auth/`):
- JWT-based authentication with secure token storage
- User session management with automatic refresh
- Password change workflows with E2EE key rewrapping
- Multi-factor authentication support

**Encryption Engine** (`src/crypto/`):
- End-to-end encryption for notes, events, and attachments
- Key management with password and recovery code support
- Migration utilities for data format updates
- Performance-optimized native KDF implementation

**Calendar Integration** (`src/calendarSync.ts`, `src/google/`):
- Bidirectional sync with device calendars
- Google Calendar API integration with OAuth2
- Conflict detection and resolution
- Background sync tasks for automatic updates

**Audio Processing** (`src/audio/`):
- Voice recording with automatic transcription
- Voice activity detection (VAD) for efficient processing
- Audio retention policies and cleanup
- Speech-to-text integration

### Configuration Approach
- **Environment Variables**: Build-time configuration through `app.config.js`
- **Feature Flags**: Runtime toggles for gradual rollouts
- **Platform Abstraction**: Conditional imports for platform-specific implementations
- **Secure Storage**: Encrypted storage for sensitive data using expo-secure-store

### External Dependencies
- **React Native & Expo**: Cross-platform mobile development framework
- **@noble/ciphers**: Cryptographic primitives for E2EE
- **expo-calendar**: Device calendar access and synchronization
- **expo-audio**: Audio recording and playback capabilities
- **react-native-mmkv**: High-performance local storage
- **posthog-react-native**: Analytics and user behavior tracking

### Integration Points
- **Backend API**: RESTful API communication with error handling and retry logic
- **Google Services**: OAuth2 integration for Google Calendar and authentication
- **Share Intent**: Native sharing from other applications
- **Notifications**: Push notifications and local scheduling
- **File System**: Document picker and file management

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Note Management**:
- Rich text editing with markdown support
- Image attachment and inline embedding
- Tagging and categorization system
- Search and filtering capabilities
- Pinning and organization features

**Calendar Integration**:
- Two-way sync with device calendars
- Event creation and modification
- Reminder and notification system
- Recurring event support
- Time zone handling

**Voice Recording**:
- High-quality audio recording
- Automatic speech-to-text conversion
- Voice activity detection
- Recording management and playback
- Integration with notes and events

**Security & Privacy**:
- End-to-end encryption for all data
- Secure key escrow with recovery options
- Biometric authentication support
- Privacy-focused analytics
- Data export and deletion capabilities

### Implementation Highlights

**Performance Optimizations** (`app/(tabs)/index.tsx`):
- Virtualized list rendering for large datasets
- Memoized computations to prevent unnecessary re-renders
- Efficient image loading and caching strategies
- Debounced search functionality

**Offline Capabilities** (`src/offlineSync.ts`):
- Local-first data architecture
- Background synchronization when connectivity is available
- Conflict resolution for concurrent modifications
- Queue-based operation management

**User Experience** (`src/components/`):
- Consistent design system with reusable components
- Loading states and skeleton screens
- Error boundaries and graceful degradation
- Accessibility considerations

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Unauthenticated
    Unauthenticated --> Authenticated: Login/Signup
    Authenticated --> NotesList: Browse Notes
    Authenticated --> Editor: Create/Edit Note
    Authenticated --> Settings: Configure App
    
    NotesList --> Editor: Create New
    NotesList --> Calendar: View Events
    Editor --> NotesList: Save Note
    Calendar --> NotesList: Back
    
    Authenticated --> OfflineMode: No Network
    OfflineMode --> Authenticated: Network Available
    
    Editor --> VoiceRecording: Record Audio
    VoiceRecording --> Editor: Transcribe
```

The application demonstrates sophisticated engineering practices with its focus on security, performance, and user experience. The modular architecture allows for easy maintenance and scaling, while the offline-first approach ensures reliability across different network conditions.

- [src/crypto/e2ee.ts](src/crypto/e2ee.ts)
- [src/calendarSync.ts](src/calendarSync.ts)
- [app/(tabs)/index.tsx](app/(tabs)/index.tsx)
